runner: Claude Code subagent (general-purpose type), fresh context, one run, no retries
prompt: You are running as the agent defined in <run-dir>/agent.md. Read that file first: the text after its frontmatter is your instructions, and its `tools:` line is the only access you may use (Read, Grep, Glob). Then do the task those instructions describe on the export folder <run-dir>/export/ . Read only files inside <run-dir>/ and nothing else on disk. The pattern doc the instructions mention is not provided; work without it. When finished, write your complete output, exactly as you would present it to the person who asked, to <run-dir>/output.md with the Write tool. That is the only file you may write. Then hand back the single word: done.
prompt_note: Exact prompt, except that the absolute path of the run folder (a local path) is replaced by <run-dir>.
isolation: The run folder held only agent.md and the export CSVs. Read-only access was set by the prompt, not by a sandbox; the session also loaded the host project's own CLAUDE.md, which is unrelated to these datasets. The only file the run wrote was output.md.
